top_signals.title: Crude oil prices and refinery margins generally increased throughout the third quarter
top_signals.summary: Petroleum markets in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26) were characterized by increasing prices for crude oil and petroleum products amid persistent conflict in the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BMO's Davis Says 30-Year Treasury Yields Will Hit 6%
top_signals.summary: Earl Davis, BMO Global Asset Management fixed income and money markets head, says it's inevitable that 30-year treasury bond yields will cross 6%. He says it could happen this month and explains the call on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
